question: Listeners with high or low working memory repeated one voice aloud while their name was played in the ignored ear. Which group noticed it more?
answer: The low group. Working memory here means holding information in mind while shutting out distraction. Conway, Cowan and Bunting found that 65% of low scorers heard their own name in the channel they had been told to ignore, against 20% of high scorers. Hearing it meant attention had leaked away from the task.
move: Noticing everything can be a sign of weak control, not keen awareness.
trap: Assuming a better memory catches more of what goes past.

diagram.caption: Share who heard their own name in the ear they were told to ignore.

reference: Conway, Cowan & Bunting, The cocktail party phenomenon revisited: the importance of working memory capacity, Psychonomic Bulletin & Review, 2001
